notes: This source is a FINRA landing page for the AML Template for Small Firms; it describes the template and its update history but does not contain the template's own substantive text (the downloadable document is not included). The only in-scope program-establishment content is the high-level statement that small firms must establish the AML program required by the BSA, its implementing regulations, and FINRA Rule 3310. The actual pillar-by-pillar duties reside in FINRA Rule 3310 and the downloadable template, which are not in this source. Modality 'must' is inferred from the word 'required' in the source (the underlying rule text uses 'shall' but is not quoted here). 'Firms should also note' is treated as a should-obligation per the text's own wording. Much of the source is website chrome/navigation with no scope-relevant content.
